answer: Fund shared work with pairwise-bonus matching: a grant's bonus grows with distinct supporters, but the formula discounts pairs that fund the same projects, so look-alike backers count almost as one. In this grove every onyx-hard contribution is weighed by how widely its roots spread, not by how many trunks share one root. A Sybil farmer minting a thousand identities must scatter real money across truly different projects to earn the bonus; fakes funding only each other earn nearly nothing, while one honest juniper of a supporter, rooted in real work, carries full weight.
